label: r4c3
name: Axial + ent0.03 + 90 short updates
hypothesis: Same as r3c2 (entropy 0.03), but each update collects 64 environments × 16 steps and splits them into 16 minibatches of 64 samples. That gives about 90 PPO updates instead of 45, with twice the Adam steps and fresher policies. Earlier, more frequent updates helped (r1c2 over r1c1), and training was still rising at the end. Refuted if dev success is at or below 0.37. A collapse of either seed would mean the shorter rollouts give GAE estimates that are too noisy.
last_analysis: The main barrier was the hidden 4-column shift. Full-span circular axial mixing (rowmix plus colmix) solved it: starting from 0, these runs place about 99% of their cells inside the target. All the gains since then came from the training recipe. Frequent updates (64 environments × 32 steps) helped. Two epochs and the 1x lean network both collapsed toward DONE or weak results. A longer horizon did not help. Two changes each raised the best seed: an entropy coefficient of 0.03 (r3c2, 0.37, the best mean) and 64-sample minibatches (r3c1, 0.457 on one seed). Seed variance is still about ±0.15, so single comparisons are weak. In the traces the agent places correct bricks but stops with DONE before upper layers and some columns are complete, and training success was still rising at the end. More optimiser progress per sample and continued exploration look like the levers. With 3 trials left, I am combining and extending the two changes that helped on the best network.
